headline: Law extends funding authority for the National Firefighter Registry for Cancer through 2028.
what_it_does: This law renews the National Firefighter Registry for Cancer through fiscal year 2028. The registry is run by the National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH). Firefighters can choose to join it, and it collects health and job information to help researchers understand and reduce cancer among firefighters.

who_it_affects.how: Firefighters can keep choosing to join the registry and share their health and work information for cancer research through 2028.

who_it_affects.group: National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH)
who_it_affects.how: The agency is authorized to keep running and maintaining the registry through fiscal year 2028.
Researchers can continue to use registry data to study cancer risks linked to firefighting.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted December 12, 2024; reauthorizes the registry through fiscal year 2028.
